name: Dietary supplements (US)
payer: Manufacturer pays private verifiers; verification is voluntary.
access: Voluntary submission of samples and facility audits.
publication: Verification marks public; adverse event reports to FDA.
ai_analogue: A regime that moved backward: pre-market review removed by statute, private verification never made mandatory, no oversight of the verifiers. Shows that a trigger does not guarantee reform.

milestones.event: DSHEA removes pre-market approval for supplements.
USP launches a voluntary supplement verification program.
Ephedra-linked deaths, including a professional athlete.
milestones.trigger_criterion: Deaths linked to ephedra including a professional athlete

milestones.event: Dietary Supplement and Nonprescription Drug Consumer Protection Act requires serious adverse event reporting.
FDA current good manufacturing practice rule for supplements.

mechanisms.note: Voluntary marks; no oversight of verifiers.
